sentences.text:
Heard the learned senior counsel appearing for
 the petitioner.

2. The learned senior Counsel submits that the food
 safety officer, upon receipt of the report from the
 office o

f the Chief Public Analyst, State Food  Laboratory, Nacharam, Hyderabad, dated  27.06.2015, filed a complaint against the  petitioner company and others under Sections  3(1)(zz)(iii), (xi), (xii), 26(2)(i), read with  Regulation 2.1.1(2) of the Food Safety and  Standards (Food Contaminants and Residues)
 Regulations, 2011, and punishable under Section  59(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
 2006.

entities.text:
Food Safety and  Standards (Food Contaminants and Residues)
 Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. The learned senior counsel further submits that  the Central Government has notified specific  laboratories authorized to analyze food samples.

It is further submitted that the State Food  Laboratory is not an accredited laboratory for  issuing certificates of this nature.
 4.
Considering the same, there shall be stay of all  further proceedings in C.C. No.1045 of 2016 on  the file of the Additional Judicial Magistrate of  First Class, Anantapuramu.

entities.text: Additional Judicial Magistrate of  First Class, Anantapuramu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to serve personal notice on the 2nd respondent and file proof of service in the registry.
